reviews.text: Remember SSI (Strategic Simulations Inc.)? Founded 1979 SSI was THE Company for strategic Wargames (Like PANZER GENERAL) and Roleplay Games (AD&D like POOL OF RADIANCE) In my Eyes their golden Era was on the Commodore 64 (C64) where they published most of their best Games. In 1986 they realeased WIZARD´S CROWN. It was their first RPG. I remember playing so many Hours, because this Game was, what we call today hardcore. Remembering that a simple Encounter took About 20 to 30 Minutes if you don´t used the Quick Combat Option. Goal of the Game was to find the Crown of the Wizard. Years went by and i sadly forgot About it. Until 3 days ago. Welcome to CROWNSEEKER! Well, CROWNSEEKER was gifted to me and at first sight i was so excited because of the wonderfull Retro Graphics. Afer staring and playing i remembered WIZARD´S CROWN. So much in Common. But thank God no 30 Minute fights. CROWNSEEKER is truly inspired by WIZARD´S CROWN and is a very nice homage to it. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748586860 It is your Goal to find the Crown, but before you must find Relics. If you got them all, go, get the Crown for the Win. Sounds easy? You wish so. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748587588 Your Party has a Wizard and a Priest. Their spells are you Weapons against Monsters. But in different Timezones. Mage cast by day and Priest by Night. The Relics are also in 2 Zones. Gold Relics visible Dawn to Dusk and Purple Relics from Dusk to Dawn. Resting at Fireplaces helps you to Change it. What i learned is, that the hardest Enemy you have ist your Hunger. Collect Food on your Way, otherwise it cames fastly to a Game over. The Maps are from small to Big, depending on the Difficulty. https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3748587711 What can i say? CROWNSEEKER is suprisingly addicting. The Runs are short and there are Special Daily Maps but you can also create a Random Map. So no Run is like the Other. After a Run you get Points and there are Leaderboards. And it is pure fun to hunt for higher Scores. Depending on how you compete a Run can be short or Long. In this Case you can save your Game. There are also Achievements. A big thanks for the Dev for returning such good Memories, you did a very good Job here. And thank YOU for Reading. Very addicting Homage to SSI´s WIZARD´S CROWN from 1986.
